hearing.quote: Laurel gets a work scope residents can inspect and a filing number the Clerk can verify — a promise is not progress until it's on paper.
hearing.actionAsked: Require direct Laurel outreach, a published work scope matched to the district's recorded complaints, and a Clerk filing reference before any progress claim is made.

hearing.quote: The people who called 911 in Fruitvale and East Oakland get to see their own numbers in their own neighborhood before this program takes one more step.
hearing.actionAsked: Execute and publish the D3 Fruitvale briefing record with district-level and Fruitvale data; hold expansion; mark the D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review as outstanding.

hearing.quote: The renewal ordinance is on the table with the scope that works — businesses and residents both eligible, 23 days processing, every closeout record public. I'm not announcing a new tranche, because renewal is council's call to make and my job is to make the record clean enough for them to make it.
hearing.actionAsked: ACT — Call for council consideration of the transmitted charter-renewal ordinance with business-and-resident scope, the 23-day processing standard, and the C114 closeout evidence intact; announce no new tranche this cycle.

hearing.quote: Clinical dollars require clinical proof, and an open health center still owes the public its Q3 intake audit and an on-the-ground merchant walkthrough.
hearing.actionAsked: Enforce the scheduled Q3 clinical intake audit filing to HCAI and the Council Clerk, complete the recurring Telegraph & 47th merchant verification walkthrough, and authorize zero new operational appropriations.

hearing.quote: Fruitvale gets the briefing and the numbers in the daylight — expansion waits until the audit and the Baylight review are actually done.
hearing.actionAsked: Publish the D3 briefing record with date, venue, notice, accessibility, district data, and Clerk filing reference; keep expansion held until the D5 audit and Baylight review are complete.

hearing.quote: My stated YES is not a roll call, and a proposed allocation track is not delivered funding.
hearing.actionAsked: The supplied record does not establish whether a recorded vote occurred. My prior YES was a stated position, not a recorded vote; request the Clerk and tracker record to reconcile the failed status and determine whether any Chinatown or Uptown appropriations were authorized.

hearing.quote: A filing claim is not a Clerk reference; verify the record before we take it up.
hearing.actionAsked: Table council review until the Clerk provides a filing reference or the record explicitly establishes that filing has not occurred.

hearing.quote: An individual affirmative vote is not an enacted ordinance; District 8 votes YES to secure Chen-Vega fiscal controls, but final disposition rests on a certified roll call.
hearing.actionAsked: Execute and record the official full-council roll-call vote on INIT-009 with all Chen-Vega audit and milestone reporting conditions attached.

hearing.quote: Routine city maintenance and targeted public health follow-through must protect our commercial vitality without inventing new bureaucratic machinery.
hearing.actionAsked: Assign executive health follow-up with a lead agency and public reporting timeline for the Piedmont Avenue health spike while maintaining municipal baseline services.
